facts.program: SMUD My Energy Optimizer Partner+ battery enrollment incentive
facts.claim: My Energy Optimizer Partner+ enrollment incentive: $300 per kWh up to $6,000 for interconnection applications from Sept 23, 2026; $500 per kWh up to $10,000 for projects submitted by Sept 22 and enrolled by Dec 31, 2026.
